note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Only the relationships listed in a preset are drawn; none is causal unless the author supplies kind 'causal'.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Five parts: library bay, source page, the user's request, the index flag (hub) and the fact card. Four supplied relationships (two plain relations, one communication, one sequence); the tracer goes request → flag → page → flag → card while the flag enlarges and a copy of ¶3 rides onto the card.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different source (site-meeting minutes, ¶2 pinpointed), a fifth relationship from the card back to the page (the citation the entry keeps), a traversal that returns from the card to the page along it, and the card as the focus part.
